title: Object pronouns
tags: me you him her it us them
summary: Use object pronouns after verbs and prepositions.

explanation.en: Object pronouns receive the action: me, you, him, her, it, us, them.
explanation.ru: Объектные местоимения используются после глагола или предлога: me, you, him, her, it, us, them.

commonMistakes.note: After a verb, use the object form.
After a preposition, use an object pronoun.
